verdict.rationale: Sunbiz's public start-business page lists print-and-mail PDF forms (Profit and Non-Profit Articles of Incorporation). The probe notes the dos.fl.gov guidance pages remain open, which suggests no account is needed to reach them. However, the evidence never shows downloadable instructions accompanying the forms, nor a print-and-mail form for LLCs or other entity types (LLC formation is listed only as online filing). Missing for 10: evidence of downloadable form instructions, coverage of forms beyond the two corporation articles, explicit confirmation that downloads require no account, independent or hands-on verification.

support.subject: As a founder, the forms themselves and their instructions are downloadable from the service's site without an account

citations.quote: Print & Mail Form: Profit Articles of Incorporation (PDF), Non-Profit Articles of Incorporation (PDF)
The dos.fl.gov guidance pages remain open.
